title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Program Funding and Employer Charge Shares
content:
Each program of Unemployment Benefit Claims is financed by its own fund, and each weekly payment is charged to state-registered base-period employers at the program's employer charge share.

| Program | Fund that finances the program's payments | Employer charge share of each weekly payment | Reissued replacement payment excluded from a second employer charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | State trust fund | 1.0 | Yes |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | Federal employing agency | 0.0 | Yes |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | Military branch | 0.0 | Yes |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | State trust fund | 1.0 | Yes |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | State and federal shared | 0.5 | Yes |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | Federal trade adjustment funds | 0.0 | Yes |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | FEMA disaster funds | 0.0 | Yes |

## Reading the share

An employer charge share of 1.0 charges the whole of each weekly payment to state-registered base-period employers, a share of 0.5 charges one half, and a share of 0.0 charges none of it.
